notes.title: Mega version update
notes.content:
Hello Captains!

It has been a long time since the last updates, we are happy to share the news that we have an mega version to update!

The focus of development revolves around the improvement of the core game experience, new AI-added PVP mode, new air-craft related parts and some suprising things. 

We received lots of feedback and suggestions raised by you guys and fixed or optimized more than 70% of them. At the same time, you can try out the new multiplayer content which was mentioned most from you.

In the future, we will develop more single-player gameplay, more community-based Ship Expo, automatic and flight-related parts. We have basically completed the development of these contents and we can update them in the next versions.

Here are our release notes for this update

Updates
Adds
1. Add key modification function: You guys can set the button according to your own habits.
2. Add options for frame rate which limit 120 gear or unlimited gear.
3. Add camera controller option: Added camera operation mode based on FPS game control rules
4. Add a shadow cascade option: which can be adjusted to greatly optimize rendering performance.
5. Add the template loading function: if you don't want to take the boat by yourself, you can quickly play the game through the template boats we provide for each mode.
6. Add the function of operation manual: you can quickly view and adjust the case of the ship interaction part.
7. Add price sorting function for Glory Store: although it is not very useful, it still supports everyone to sort and buy.
8. New PVP defense mode: big update!
9. Add function of invite friends in PVP mode: big update! Everyone can invite friends to join the room in PVP.
10. Add custom rule function in PVP mode: big update! Players can adjust room rules when creating a PVP room.
-Set the maximum number of players
-Set the maximum number of parts
-Set the game time limit
-Set race laps in Racing mode.
11. New AI function in PVP mode.
12. New AI in racing mode.
13. New flight-related/blade parts
14. New direction key response of ships in novice guide: big update, when the number of players in the room is not enough, you can play PVP games by adding AI.
15. Delete mandatory process of novice guide: big update, racing mode also supports AI racing.

other:
1. Add flight blade part - with basic aerodynamic algorithm, supporting players to take off in place.
2. Add arrow key response to tutorial ship - tutorial experience optimization.
3. Increase item distribution in Open Sea - Enhanced rewards and experience in Open Sea.
4. The tutorial is removed from the compulsory process - although we always hope that you can play other modes after understanding the basic mechanics of the game, but according to the feedback from community players, we finally turned off the mandatory process of the tutorial to increase the freedom of the game.

Fixed:
1. Fix the parameter adjustment after multiple parts selections.
2. Fixed the bug that the center of gravity of the ship was randomly positioned after module combined.
3. Optimize the sound effect caused by too many combine and separate  functions
4. Fix the problem that each combine and unbind will cause the object to fall off ( lost joint connection).
5. Fix the issue that the ship in the tutorial cannot be loaded.
6. Fix the bug of overlapping game Background Musics in the boot scene.
7. Fix the bug of tutorial scene camera threading.
8. Fix the interaction bugs between gate and hook claw in Campaign1 Level4.
9. Fix the crystal interaction bug of Campaign1 Level7.
10. Repair Campaign3 Level1 iceberg collision.
11. Fix the bug that PVP players' HP is not synchronized.
12. Fix the bug of template loading failure in Open Sea.
13. Optimize the issue that the number of parts clicked for collection is not limited in Open Sea.
14. Fix the bug of refreshing the level of Open Sea.
...
There are a total of 65 other bugs that affect player experience, game fluency, and interactive feedback


In the future, we will optimize rendering performance as we continue production!

 Thank you for your long-term feedback, suggestions and attention. Your support and affirmation are our motivation.
Finally, we wish you all a happy Chinese new year, happy games and have a happy life

notes.title: Sea of Craft - State of Development
notes.content:
Hello Captains!

We know it has been a long time since the last update and we wanted to share news with the community over the state of Sea of Craft development before the holiday break. 

First, we will participate in the Steam Winter Game Festival at a discount! 
But, most importantly, we want to tell you what we have been working on lately. The focus of development revolves around the improvement of the core game experience, frame optimization and build stability. 

1. Core gameplay experience improvements. (Including camera recorder, build feeling and build functions)
2. Framerate and build stability optimizations.
3. A new Ship Expo (many more social functions than the current version)
4. A new PVP mode (great optimization of new mode and existing mode)
5. New automation and flight parts
6. New single level

Now, we know that you want to know when some of those improvements will be available in the game. We are working to push a new game update in the next couple of weeks.

But that is not all, we have been working to fix a series of bugs submitted by players in the community. 

The development team is grateful for the feedback and suggestions raised by the captains, and we are working to address what we reasonably can do to create a better Sea of Craft.

Adventure never stops. Let’s sail!

We wish you all a Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!

notes.content:

    Captains! Glad to tell you that in the next update we will bring you some giant changes! In the last two months we have prioritized the multiplayer mode based on the feedbacks from you. There have been a lot of improvements made to the multiplayer content. Captains will be able to experience more intense and exciting PVP gameplay in the future! 
    We also prepared a brand new mode: Multiplayer Defense Mode - cooperate with other captains against enemy ships! However, as the patch stability has not been tested, we need more time to make sure the version is stable enough to release. All the new contents will be live in the upcoming version soon, please stay tuned!

We optimized the aerodynamic function and made a new part-Paddle (testing)  , which can be used for the implementation of fixed-wing aircraft construction. However, the parameters of this part is not stable, we will keep optimize until it's good enough. Please remember to save the SOC file frequently.

Three kinds of Battle Axe part

Thanks again to all the captains for your support! Hope you all have fun in Sea of Craft!

notes.title: Update Announcement May 13
notes.content:
Foreword
After a week of troubleshooting, we are excited to push the latest version live. Some of the high priority problems reported by players in the past week have mostly been fixed in this update.

When the update is complete, you should be able to have a feeling that our game runs much more smoother than before, because we have repaired and refactored a lot of logic in memory management and usage. At the same time, we adjust parameter of several parts which are frequently used to optimize the buoyancy performance. The remaining mparts will be adjusted after fully tested, and will be updated sequently.

At present, we have fixed most of the problems that can be reproduced and located. We have recorded the feedback of some bizarre bugs (such as system compatibility, hardware, etc.), but since there is no other relevant information, we can only rely on our teamates to manually investigate them. But don't worry, any issues we've promised to fix will eventually be resolved.

The focus of the next update will gradually shift to the optimization and iteration of the game experience. We will solve the camera control, construction feel, custom buttons, adsorption and other problems that comes from our players feedback when the game is launched.

Thanks again to all the players who gave us suggestions and support in the past two weeks!

-------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------- --------

[/olist]

[/olist]

Hope you have great time in Sea of Craft!

notes.title: Sea of Craft First Week In Review!
notes.content:
Dear Captains!

Since our grand EA launch seven days ago we have received boatloads of feedback and suggestions addressing numerous important shortcomings in the current build of Sea of Craft. In spite of these shortcomings, we feel reassured having the ongoing support and encouragement of our awesome player base. With your help, we can continue to explore towards new horizons together, getting better and better along the way!

In the week since launch we have been burning the candle at both ends thanks to the incessant appearance of problems we could never even have imagined of prior to release:


Problems and poor gameplay experience related to design and building restrictions in tutorial levels
Game operations and perspective tools as featured in Maya and Unity not fitting players’ preferences
Critical loading errors and poor gameplay experience caused by differences in counting systems between countries
Reversed default language settings (Chinese, English)
Frustrating Open Sea death experience, bosses appearing without warning
Vestigial ghosts, flickering visuals in the crafting system
Locked cursor and framerate limit problems caused by substandard displays on developer systems (player demands on framerate limits exceeded our expectations)


Most of the problems above were tested, fixed and patched as soon as you flagged them. Other than a couple of hardware problems, most of these are optimisations related to the gameplay experience. We are actively working on all bug fixes and optimisations that come our way and we are sparing no effort to bring the vibrant world of Beella to life and make our game well and truly ship-shape.

The good news is that throughout the week, industrious captains like you from around the world have been hard at work at the shipyard:

We saw a towering building rising from the ground in the desert oasis

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/a5e1ffc6366438d6bfa65ff5d232fba87a8a9428.png

We saw a squadron of tanks assembling on the sands of the archipelago

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/39198e7b31c0ac3afa80bfe1f2ecbc4d3f2d3471.jpg

We saw a full-size destroyer-class warship cruising the open ocean

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/4b1ee4cb67594583c19a1b8cd7b1c47edab24528.png

And we saw Captains striving tirelessly to achieve their dreams of flight high up in the sky

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/6a9b3db2028d11e107496f116692eba99b19ace4.gif

Alongside the shipbuilding maestros busily building away in Creative Mode are the legends fighting fiercely to tame the Open Sea. At the time of writing, legendary Captain “Leji” has reached the soaring heights of Level 77! The gruesome monster of the southern seas are shivering in their timbers and quaking their tentacles in fear!

The road ahead is long. But with the company of our beloved Captains the journey will surely be a merry one! We will overcome one difficulty after another as surely as you will prevail over the perils of the Open Sea. Together, let us ride the wind and break the waves!

notes.title: Update Announcement May 2
notes.content:
About the camera movement bug, we have searched related issues on the internet and checked a thousand times, but there still comes out that players with this issue. Finally, we searched on Steam community and we found that there are many other games met the similar issue.
From other posts, seems the situation is caused by the Windows 10 installed a device called Microsoft Virtual HID Mouse. Simply remove it can probably solve the problem.

So, the recommended solution step as follows:

0. Unplug all external gaming devices such as joysticks
1. Alt+Enter twice to switch the game back and forth between windowed mode and full screen
2. Change the resolution
3. Switch the input method, if your system has an input method
4. Find the Microsoft Virtual HID Mouse device and remove it
5. If none of the above methods work, please contact us and we will check with you to find out the reason of this weird problem

We feel really sorry for some problems you encountered after entering the game for the first time.

We didn’t consider the difference of number formats between different countries system during the development process, which caused players in some countries to not be able to build their ships correctly. Now this problem has been fixed.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We keep working for 2 days and now we believe most of the game loop bugs have been solved, along with some experience optimization suggestions, they will get updated in today's upcoming update. And we have scheduled the awaiting problems fix in the future update.

As we said in the annoucement when your first enter Sea of Craft, release of EA version does not mean the end of our development, but rather the blowing of a forward charge. We know there's a long way to go, but we are confident that with all the captains' company and support, we'll definitely make Sea of Craft a great game in the future!

We sincerely appreciate every captain's suggestion no matter you supported, encouraged or trolled, abused our game. There is no love or hate come from no reason, and we believe even the most intense emotions represent your desire that Sea of Craft could be better than now, and we are 100% willing to listen to your opinions!

notes.title: A Letter from the development team
notes.content:
Ahoy, Sea Captains!I am Chang Mao, the producer of Sea of Craft. First of all, I would like to thank all you Captains who have been supporting us for such a long time. At the same time, a warm welcome to all the new Captains who have made port at the ocean world of Beella. Let’s get ready to sail!

After loads of public tests and with the joint efforts of the whole team, the Early Access version of “Sea of Craft” will finally go live on April 28, 2022! I hope that everyone can create their own unique battleships in the game, and enjoy whatever twists and turns your Sea of Craft adventure brings. May the sound of the tides here in the southern seas of Beella bring you peace and joy.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/990920/_/

The Early Access release is not the end for our R&D - it is a milestone on a much longer journey to and beyond full release. On top of the core framework we’ve already implemented, we also have plenty of cool features and concepts that we want to share with all Captains via Sea of Craft.

In the world of Sea of Craft, Early Access release also signifies the start of the “Sea of Craft Era”. According to our schedule, once the version is stabilized, the world of Beella will usher in the first industrial revolution. Powered parts and weapons driven by new technologies will emerge, and Captains’ goals and concerns in shipbuilding will also change.

After release, our priorities will be optimising existing game content and fixing bugs. The growth and improvement of Sea of Craft requires the support of and suggestions from all Captains. If you have any questions about the game, feel free join our Discord channel or post your feedback to our Steam Community and we’ll get back to you as soon as we can. We do of course recommend you join the Sea of Craft Discord anyway. You’ll find plenty of likeminded shipmates there.

Once the Early Access version is stabilised, we will announce a large-scale Beella timeline as well as a future update plan. Below is the current status and future outlook of each part in Sea of Craft.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/2e431b35903fef4e65a11ca76837dbb35bcc8bfa.gif

Single Player

Currently, we have three chapters available, all of which incorporate guidance and part tutorials into the level objectives. Difficulty and progression pace will increase in future versions and we are committed to designing plenty of intriguing stages with extravagant simulated physics for future content releases.

In the future, we will add more stage content by taking the chapter theme as the timeline for updates. What a feeling to be moving from the shallows into the deep end!

Here are some demo gifs of future stages that have advanced simulated physics:

Gearset puzzles

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/464567c69fdd223c1bfa5778ea916b9b58cd7753.gif

Rigid hull puzzles

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/7b0dc64e5ef026740f0fdd32fc5e16143f66b4d2.gif

Driving and wheel physics

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/78c7d65af959982650b2d110a7f9558ccb03feab.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/21e8dec07436fc9e7c9bdba49faff24137d598b5.gif

Crafting Content

There are 14 advanced building functions and nearly 200 building parts in Sea of Craft. The basic building functions and parts are already available in the EA version. In the future, we will add more parts and advanced building systems to incorporate into the existing framework. THese will provide a huge helping hand to everyone who loves mechanical design.

Parts:

In our R&D plan, parts will be released gradually according to the version theme. For example, advanced steam engines, automation components and pneumatic components will be available together at a pre-defined technological milestone. Core functional parts of different sizes and styles will also be released between major updates.

Functions:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/32dbee6c13dc534cfcdbd24f7d4d483ddaf34775.png

Through our testing endeavours, our vision of gravity functions and buoyancy within Build Mode has been realised. Since the number of buoyancy calculations in Sea of Craft is multiplied by the number of parts, enabling the buoyancy preview function poses a great challenge to hardware performance. Therefore, we are designing a screening and unified processing method to optimize this issue, which will ready for general release following testing on performance metrics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/c3466d02619251f64023f11602d0dfca9da3d520.gif

Multiplayer

At present, multiplayer gameplay has three basic modes: Water Duel, Land Speed Racing and the No-limits 8-Player Free-for-All PVP. With it’s high-quality simulated physics and advanced building functions, multiplayer gameplay in Sea of Craft will is sure to be an experience of unparalleled depth.

Duel:

There are basic rules for duel and rewards spawning. On this basis, more core combat game modes can be introduced in the future, such as escort and capture the point.

Racing:

The next major update will include amphibious racing in conjunction with renewed water path design. The track design will also be more fantastical, inspired by multiplayer in of GTA V.

No-limits:

The main aim of no-limits multiplayer is to provide a space for demonstration and testing in multiplayer. A land-based no-limits mode will be added once the version is stabilized.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/6f8b6664430ded4496f4f84744edbbe5fb8917a2.gif

Open Sea

The current Open Sea area includes a PvE combat and development system based on roguelite rules. Captains can liberate strongholds and island villages that have been plundered by Kerry pirates. As a token of their gratitude, the villagers reward you with Gold Coins, which you can use to upgrade your ship.

Combat System:

In the future, more AI and Boss events will be added to the current combat framework to enhance the diversity of combat pace and experience.

Discovery Systems:

Design of the non-combat exploration system has already been completed. This depth feature will be added when the EA version is stabilized.

Map Size：

At present, a 16x16 km sea area has been completed and the 8x8 km map is live and online. The sea area in future will be gradually expanded according to the overall volume of content expected in subsequent releases.

notes.title: Sea of Craft FAQ
notes.content:
Captains, welcome to the Beela Family! Sea of Craft will be launched at 9:00pm (PT), Thursday 28th April! 

With launch just around the corner, we have compiled answers to some of the questions that may spring to mind when you first set foot in the shipyard. If you have a question that doesn’t appear here, please feel free to join our official Discord channel and discuss it with us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/990920/_/

Frequently Asked Questions:
 
Q: What is the retail price of Sea of Craft?
A: The game is priced at $14.99 during EA, with a 10% discount for the first week of release!

Q: Will the price go up later?
A: We plan to increase the price slightly when Early Access is over, depending on what new features and gameplay enhancements have been added in the meantime.

Q: What is the exact date of release?
A: 9:00pm (PT), Thursday 28th April! Don't miss it, there is a 10% discount on purchases within the first week of release!

Q: How many gameplay hours can I expect from Sea of Craft? Will there be many bugs?
A: At this stage, Sea of Craft can be seen as a playable demo with the most gameplay loop already complete. As it stands, the game content is mainly composed of single-player levels, a range of multiplayer combat gameplay (Multiplayer), large scenario PvE (Open Sea), a creative mode (Creative), a full shipbuilding system and ship sharing features.

After several rounds of testing prior to launch, EA version content proved to be stable and playable. We will continue to optimize and improve the game content after the launch. Of course if you encounter any bugs please join our channels and report them!

As for total gameplay hours, we don't think there is a specific playable time for reference because of the wide-ranging open-ended modes on offer.. If you are a big fan of building, you can spend thousands of hours making your builds bigger and better!

 
Q: What game modes are currently available in Sea of Craft?
A: There are currently four modes in Sea of Craft: Chapters / Creative / Multiplayer / Open Sea

Chapters is a mode where the player designs, builds and pilots ships from a limited parts list to fulfil specific and varied level objectives. Upon fulfilling the level objectives, the player progresses to the next level. Each chapter is composed of three levels, each of which is designed according to the chapter theme. Three chapters are available in this release version and more chapters will be added in the future.

Creative mode, as the name implies, is a mode for unleashing unbridled creativity. As such, there are no limitations on building parts in this mode. Currently, there are three built-in stages for your building activities: Desert Oasis, Islands and Endless Ocean. Choose the stage that best meets your building and testing needs.

Multiplayer is a PvP mode where captains do fierce battle with one another. Test your designs in Creative mode and create the ultimate PvP build! Whether you’re fighting on land or sea, your building expertise and piloting prowess are the only difference between victory and defeat.

The Open Sea resembles roguelite gameplay. Liberate strongholds by defeating pirates and use the proceeds to upgrade your ship!

Q: Is there a leaderboard in the game?
A: Yes! There are leaderboards for both single player levels and the Open Sea!

Q: Are there any in-game purchases? Do I need kryptonite?
A: Sea of Craft is a premium title containing no in-game purchases. You can’t go wrong buying one copy: buy two copies to earn blood!

Q: Is there an achievement system?
A: Yes!

Q: Is there a buddy system?
A: There is currently no buddy system - our PVP mode is designed around joining a room to play solo against player opponents.

Q: Is Sea of Craft an online game?
A: Yes! Multiplayer is unlocked by completing the first single player level. After that you can build your own PvP battleship and join the battle!

Q: How many players does the game support at most? What is the balance mechanism of multiplayer mode?
A: Currently Multiplayer supports up to 8 players on the same stage, but in the future we will consider expanding this to 16 players. For performance reasons, we currently limit the maximum number of parts per game to 1600. For example, players in an 8-player room can each use up to 200 parts. Accordingly, each ship in a 4-player room can comprise up to 400 parts. You can toggle part limits in Creative to help you easily build ships that conform to the requirements of different rooms.

Q: Will there be a mobile version?
A: There is no specific plan for this. Please follow our channels - this may one day be a reality!

Q: How many people are there in the game production team?
A: We are an independent game studio, currently a small team of about ten people.

Q: When is the next game update?
A: We will release updates systematically. In due course we will announce an update an update schedule. Please follow our socials for the latest news!

Q: Does the game require high-performance hardware?
A: The game currently relies foremost on CPU power. Because of the nature of physics building games, the larger the object built the greater the CPU capacity consumed. The development team attaches great importance to performance optimization, and we will continue to make adjustments after the game is launched to ensure a smooth gameplay experience!

Q: Is there a photo mode in the game?
A: Of course there is! You can take a group photo after the completion of a masterpiece at the Shipyard by pressing F7. Photo mode includes many features such as time-of-day control, weather control, time pause, hide UI, doodling and unfixed camera view, etc.! Go try it out in Creative mode!


Known Bugs (will be fixed in subsequent versions):
 
[olist]
In some cases, the center of gravity of a blueprint will shift after combining all selected parts.

Occasional unexplained jittering

Batch of words: this is the most realistic physics simulation!
Unpredictable physics interactions: the parts that compose your builds in Sea of Craft are held together by dynamic physics-based linkages. For the game to work properly, these linkages need to be continually updated via renewed physics calculations to take state changes from collisions, mechanism changes etc. into account. In larger builds, the number of calculations is correspondingly large and the complexity of deformations between part linkages increases. Sometimes lag and unpredictable behaviours can therefore arise. Currently the only solution is limitations on numbers of parts in multiplayer. For improved performance, use the ‘Combine’ tool when building - this simplifies the physics interactions within the Combined component.
Stream Saver: legacy physics bug that is very hard to fix.

[/olist]

Dev-oriented Questions:

Q: What is the correct procedure to report a bug?
A: First, briefly describe the bug you encountered, preferably with pictures. We will also collect your feedback from the official Discord channel. In some cases we may need the player's log to locate the problem: the path of the log is usually C:\Users\your computer username\AppData\LocalLow\WizardGames\Sea of Craft\player.log. You need to enable ‘show hidden files’ in Windows Explorer.

Q: Is it true that there will be a stage editor function?
A: After the existing framework and version stability of the whole game has been perfected, we will use the existing building system to make a stage editor.

Q: Will there be more kinds of custom parts in the future?
A: Yes, there will be.

Q: Will there be in-game character roles in the future?
A: We are not considering making characters that can be controlled and interacted with by players, but we are considering designing a female character to join the game.

Q: Will there be more flight power parts in the future?
A: Currently we are testing an "Air Propeller" part, which can support players to make helicopters and drones. In the future there will be a set of parts specifically for flight components.

Q: What types of weapon parts will be added to the game in the future?
A: We will follow the existing model (shotgun, rifle, submachine gun, blaster) to come out with standard weapons, but we will also introduce themed weapons corresponding to the overall theme of each content release (I want to bring back the flamethrower and fire systems...).

Q: Is the game cloud-archived?
A: Blueprints (ship design files) are currently cloud-archived, and can be saved to the blueprints slot tied your account.

If you still have any questions after reading the answers above, please don't hesitate to join our Discord channel!

notes.title: Sea of Craft Early Access Version - Coming April 28th
notes.content:
How we have kept you waiting, oh long-suffering sea captains! We are delighted to announce that the Sea of Craft Early Access Version will be launching at 9:00pm (PT), Thursday 28th April! The Early Access version price will be discounted 10% for the first week only! A world of shipbuilding high jinks and ocean adventures awaits you. Save the date and dust off your charts - it’s time to set sail!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/990920/_/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/d0fce4f27dac9c44361829e5ce67485c9da98dcc.jpg

Introducing Sea of Craft
Sea of Craft is a maritime sandbox construction game with realistic simulated physics. The EA version includes the full building experience and blueprint sharing features plus single player levels, multiplayer and PvE. Choose from hundreds of individual building parts to create unique and elaborate builds all of your very own. Ignite your intrigue with head-scratching single player levels and challenge yourself to reach the top of the ranking tables. Take to the Open Sea, where dread pirates, mysterious islands and gruesome sea monsters await you!

Physics-based Construction - share your builds with the world!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/cecc71ac6845bc016d5cb241822784c54f365aed.png

Choose from a boundless ocean, a desert plain or a tranquil archipelago and set the stage for your building endeavours. Enjoy realistic simulated physics and building mechanics designed to give you as much freedom as possible. Equip your build with armor plating, mobility parts, weapons and more, and paint it with colorful sprays. With hundreds of parts to choose from your builds will be truly unique. Craft anything, from sea-skimming hovercrafts to ground-rumbling tanks; from majestic dragons to ocean abominations. Satisfy your building desires in any domain, be it sea, land or sky.

Vibrant Single Player - adventure and upgrade!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/72deab86e8f2e5def39c6af72deaaa7fdde32fca.png

Fancy a brainteaser? Check out our intricately designed themed single player levels! Underpinned by a smooth linear progression system, our single player levels take you step by step through a range of challenges that test not only your building ingenuity but also your piloting and problem-solving abilities. Grasping a cannonball with an iron hook? Or saving a group of baby alligators left adrift? It’s all here in Sea of Craft!

Alternatively, take to the high seas and do battle with fierce pirates and gruesome monsters. The risks are great - but so are the rewards. Plunder their closely guarded treasure and use it to improve your builds. Master multiplayer battles, fishing and racing and crown yourself king of the high seas!

Realistic Ocean Environment - ultimate immersion

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/03b14f2247fe706d7bff8c97425c492515cee0ba.png

Sea of Craft is a fantastic immersive experience couched in an artistic, realistic ocean environment with exquisite textures and therapeutic sound design. Set sail and feel the ocean waves rippling beneath your feet. Feel the wind in your hair and hear the ocean lapping peacefully against your hull. The countless archipelagos scattered across Beela conceal more than meets the eye. Remnants of lost civilisations from the Middle Ages to the Steam Age rupture and litter the seascape like ancient tectonic plates, confounding historians and sea captains alike!

Throughout the EA phase, we will be working diligently to optimise and improve game content based on your feedback. The full release version will feature additional building parts, combat gameplay and more - a must-have for all you hardcore shipbuilders and naval commanders!

Plot a course and follow our socials!

Discord: https://discord.gg/tXyhYTb
Twitter: https://twitter.com/seaofcraft
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/seaofcraft/
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/seaofcraft/

notes.title: Sea of Craft Update is here!
notes.content:
It's been a long time, dear captains~~~

The Sea of Craft are coming with a big wave of updates!!!

During the previous tests, wecollected and listened carefully to the massive opinions of the captains. After combining the development schedule and the priority of feedbacks, we have successively implementedframe selection parts, batch move parts and a slew of "Serious Shipbuilding Parts" that all new content captains have been waiting for! The EA version is about to be released, and we will do our best to let everyone enjoy the fun in the South Beela Sea!

This time Sea of Craft once again brought you a large number of epic updates in creative mode, including  generating custom parts, one-click copy function of frame selection parts, import and export of msoc parts set, and a new creative mode scene desert oasis! 

Now, let's introduce the specific content of this update to you~

 New function: custom size part generation, greatly optimize the performance of large-scale construction! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/41419d3cadd08ae206ff33adf7ed34cc423afbe3.gif

You can customize the size of the part. Using this part to build can greatly reduce the repetitive work of building and improve performance. For example, in the past, when you needed to build a 100*100 chassis, you needed to manually piece together wooden rafts, but when you use the custom part , you only need to enter the length, width and height to generate it with one click, and the generated part will be regarded as a part so that greatly improved build performance!

New function: multi-part selection and directly copy

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/acbb241808a5017b4417f0f0535ae45fa06c4df0.gif

Added Ctrl+D shortcut so you can copy the selected part with one click, reducing a lot of repetitive work when using a certain structure repeatedly!

New feature: part set import and export (msoc file)

On the basis of the original blueprint format soc, a new export format msoc has been added, which can be simply understood as a microsoc blueprint or a mod blueprint. Considering that there may be some highly reusable structures in the actual construction process, repeated manual construction of structures will consume the patience of captains!

This function can realize frame selection of multiple objects and export them as a structure group with one click (not limited by core block). The main purpose of the msoc part set function is to make it more convenient to spread the structure group among the core players. This function will not be embedded in the Ship Expo sharing, and we will consider adding it to the steamworkshop in the later stage!

New scene: Desert Oasis in Creative mode

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/d0f040a2c4f978abeb0c98cffa6082ec6a8ba964.gif

Updated the screen performance, rich desert materials, added pools and vegetation
New destructible scene objects: (test function) The altar in the oasis and the red pillars near the playgroundcan be realistically destroyed (there are rigid bodies and linked structures to transmit power). We will decide to add more content in the subsequent version based on the real-time fragmentation of the scene according to the feedback from you captains on the destruction effect!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/0ea0bf1c5f6be654cd97d75b3c8da97e474128fb.gif

notes.title: Sea of Craft Playtest now live!
notes.content:

We are looking forward to hear your feedback, so we plant a 'Survey' button on the right corner of the mainmenu! Click it and give us your opinions, together we can make this game better! Also you can join us on Discord ( https://discord.gg/nPKhNUZ3GB ) and share with us your experience!

Here is everything you can expect in the latest brand new demo:

1. OVERHAULED SINGLE PLAYER EXPERIENCE

We have reconstructed the single player mode, so now you captains will have a more challenging and smoother linear game experience! We're proud to introduce a mode we are calling Chapters, which has tonnes of new content as listed:
 Brand new single player level classification structure, level layout is much clearer!
 Newly designed level goals, guidance, and star challenges!
 Brand new Chapter selection interface and in-game UI!
 Themed chapters, different scenarios and levels!
This mode will be constantly expanded and we can't wait to see the creative ways you overcome these challenges.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/420b37b548b1a1744fbf80602115fb5e5a47da57.png

We have also improved the experience with features such as Multiple part selection/merging and batch moving built parts. We've also worked hard to make optimisation even better, and are pleased to confirm the blueprint loading speed is at least a hundred times faster than before too.

The era of great construction has officially begun! The only limit is your imagination.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/4bd2fbe81b6b19f9cb4cff8aca1749c61cba96db.png

4. NEWLY DESIGNED SHIP EXPO

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/2bf7709b3a3f239f76a3b93bb99db7c594346f05.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/decc08c8f265e6735462edd39b15d08f35a85214.png

5. REGISTER FOR THE TEST ON STEAM

During the testing period (December 24th - 31st) we will grant access to 2000 lucky players at random from those who signup. Don't delay! Be sure to sign up today!

Be ready to man the sails... as we have a long voyage ahead of us this December...

- The Sea of Craft Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/d649953bbd5bf70195ad03310e80cf2c0c60cd46.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/4fec0a65611200c580ce3558d6e04ab13ec8a7dd.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/95475a8fa4d557a6785091d728f81cc0c4eb6f93.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/21229a7a8056da4e00dd8e30aa503fbfd9217b33.png

notes.title: Dev Update: Captain's Log #5
notes.content:
News just in from the Captain’s Log! Deafening crashes heard in the distance of the Beela Seas reveal many big changes to have taken place recently.

DEMON ALTARS
Mysterious altars have been discovered in the Open Sea. Rumour has it that those brave enough to touch them will be blessed (or cursed) with godlike powers...

PIRATE CAMPS & STRONGHOLDS
The barrier of the Beela Sea has broken - and PIRATES have invaded. They used wooden planks to make various sea camps! Only the bravest can take them over and claim this as their own. Once a stronghold has been taken over, stop off at them to repair or upgrade.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/d938dc181d66c1d5fafc3bd94b94e85c42d9c002.png

CAMP SHOPS
After the pirate ships have been cleaned up in the camps, shops will be opened to the natives of Beela following their surrender. With daily deals and special items for sale, crafters will be able to visit these to buy additional upgrades at a fair price.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/0259540a78e5c4000814bf36e07ebe9d695fe831.png

PVP ARENA
The people of Beela found that being friendly could not be exchanged for peace, so they accelerated the construction of ‘The Arena’ and regularly held combat activities to screen the design and driving of the most powerful warships in the Beela waters. Feeling brave?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/0516dfa030edbe84bed3744b085a5ff7096b8189.png

NEW RESOURCES & WEAPONS
New materials were also discovered floating in the seas, including STEEL PARTS and RAPID FIRE WEAPONS! Many thrifty crafters have already started to put these to good use in upgrading their vessels. Here are a few:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/85a006954045969a4ceadb3bab23e9064b49f1ba.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/68ba0b43c45632ca5b5f87f0250359c942f5ee7c.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/c54a78c3e65b01e74a301e22c237bfc05c2a0fad.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/be2bd6f3b014786baa98169a45842d7c0a6eed89.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/bfde5f58bf872b5fa7dafc0913f4d14333cc0830.png

IMPROVED USER INTERFACE
Based on feedback from our crafters, the user interface has been redesigned from the ground up. Giving the whole overall look and feel of the menus a more modern and stylish feel.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/d60ab94f2585ff903073cb6a45a000144025307f.png

REPAIRED SAILS
Back by popular demand! We hired the finest captains out there to work on repairing the sails. The team has finally found the perfect balance between difficulty, control and authenticity to the sails technology.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/734898e16b6b7a8e63a6b79e420c8db053b794c0.png

BOSS SHIP
A boss-like enemy has also been sighted by some explorers. Reported to be causing terror and trouble in the Open Sea. More information on this as it becomes available…
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/e418b8bb4a8d0f9491df9d23bf03e290124d0143.png

Until next time, captains!
Over 'n' out.

notes.title: Three cheers for the survey crew! Sea charts for everyone!
notes.content:
To a cacophony of welcoming cries and shouts, the survey ship pulled into the harbor. Before the crew had even thrown the mooring lines to land, the drunkard captain plunged into the water and dragged himself onto the shore. Tossing his hard-won charts to the ground, he pushed his way through the crowds and made a beeline for the nearest pub, from which he did not emerge for three nights and three days. The people’s joy at the captain’s return is now intermingling with concern for his health.

New content:

1. Maps and newly unlocked areas. Go adventuring without fear of getting lost on the way home!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/75fd9878ff46f0a610754b137586a012d01f12c3.jpg

2. Factory open for business. The people of Beela can now manufacture new exciting Parts!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/ebbd0161e4f9c7eaf0d4f291d2d1ef68f76a6e9d.jpg
Coming soon:

1. Introduce new Open Sea game modes
2. Erect Open Sea buildings
3. Develop main UI
4. Develop new weapons and Parts

Sea of Craft Team

notes.title: Beela welcomes new friends!
notes.content:
Early one evening, when the industrious craftspeople of Beela were still hard at work, one of the laborers spied a black dot growing on the horizon. The laborers downed their tools and made haste to welcome the ship that was slowly heading their way. As the ship came nearer, the people of Beela saw that the ship was a trade vessel from the Cori Sea. The merchants and adventurers onboard were looking to exchange wares with the Kingdom of Beela. Thus the people of the Beela Archipelago got their hands on news logs, bread and fresh oranges they had been yearning after for so long.

New additions:
1. Open Sea (gameplay lobby)
	Multiplayer functionality for the Open Sea is now ready! Players can visit other players’ private waters via invitation or by searching the open lobby tables.


2. Chat System
	The Cori merchants brought sophisticated communications equipment to Beela. Players can now chat with other players anywhere in the Open Sea.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/29ecfb98d11c89f119a52df537a56430c4799528.jpg

3. Trading Center (Purchasing Station)
	To accelerate economic development, the government of Beela has undertaken to purchase resources of all grades from the people of Beela. Prices are set once per day according to the actual state of supply and demand.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/8ac491843ce69afec79f5b2fa455f7d6aceb1781.jpg

4. Guild Hall (Single Player Chapters)
	Fortune favors the bold! Here, the more adventure-minded denizens of Beela can take on open challenges including crafting conundrums to test the cognitive powers of the region’s top shipbuilders.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/80edcc51e0d922dd48c806c481940121cf317e1b.jpg

5. Arena
	Renovation work on the building is complete but there remain a few wrinkles to iron out in the PvP rules design.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/ac1bc4e86faf8c98a28b989330f792fc3bef06c8.jpg

6. Customhouse complete! This all-important hub, located in the Open Sea, allows you to travel to fellow players’ private waters and pay a visit.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/8d8aaca6ecd4bf95d4f78d6fc1022c6bfedc5357.jpg





Easter already?

To celebrate the dawn of a new era of mutual prosperity, the Beela Light Manufactory has produced a range of cute commemorative ship’s wheels!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/e0d5e58295d39cad6f2e9b625b617ba60fe38308.jpg

notes.title: CONSCRUCTION WORK UNDERWAY IN BEELA!
notes.content:
Lately, one bright and sunny afternoon, the people of Beela finished construction work on their eagerly anticipated Shipyard and Warehouse. New freight channels were thus laid in place, linking the states of Beela in mutual prosperity. In the course of their fervent trading and wild adventures, they came upon the hulking remains of an arena in the seas to the north of the Toby Archipelago, seemingly left behind by a civilisation from a past age. In the spirit of putting all things to good use, they undertook minor renovations and set about organising competitions. 

Together, the states of Beela have recently been devising rules of engagement for their new competitions. Also underway are discussions about the paint job – there is some debate over which colors would best embody the spirit of the Beela South Sea.

New content:

1. Item pick-up and storage functions added for use in the open ocean environment. Players will now be able to gather litter from the sea, as well as valuable resources. Use your powers for good, captains!

2. System of resources (including Parts) at the Shipyard and Warehouse formalised and completed. Players no longer need bob aimlessly across the ocean or run aground in search of driftwood.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/4eae05463f7716ed6d14fa482cfda0fc93d83e57.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/d765f7d2480fbd0dd3946b59904d8907c23a4897.jpg

3. Arena and Purchasing Station added (artificial floating islands).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/361357f5cecb790ebca5aaf0619dbe2426e65c59.jpg
Future plans:

1. Expand Purchasing Station functions.

2. Build more buildings.

3. Finish weapons tests in preparation for next game version.

4. Create more Single Player scenarios.

notes.title: Beela’s Got Talent – The Sea Is Your Stage!
notes.content:
Beela’s Got Talent – The Sea Is Your Stage!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/a5501d54ff3faa02648715e3272fb0f0d60ca4c7.jpg


Calling all captains! Calling all captains! Are you the best shipwright in the entire world? Then look no further! Sign up for Beela’s Got Talent – Sea of Craft’s first official shipbuilding competition event. All participants will get a copy of Limited Summer Sprays for free, and submitting a top-three entry will win you the Sea of Craft Early Access! 

Sea of Craft is a physics-based sea construction game that puts you in command of over 76 unique parts (many more in the full release!), allowing for endless shipbuilding possibilities. Creativity is at the heart of Sea of Craft and there really are no limits. You can build and sail anything from a Roman galley to a piglet or a castle, so long as you can make it float!

Go head to head with your fellow shipbuilders and show the judges the difference between shipwright and shipwrong. To submit your entry, post a short video of your winning ship to Twitter or Youtube, showing off its maritime charms. Then message us on Twitter or our Beela’s Got Talent Discord subchannel with a link to your video. Finally, sit back, cruise the South Sea and wait for the winners announcement on July 6th. Let’s get building!

Details

16th-30th June		Submissions accepted
6th July		                Winners announced

Rules

1. Each individual applicant may submit multiple entries.
2. Entries must be the applicant’s own work (no piracy please).
3. No offensive content, explicit or implicit, is allowed

Sea of Craft Team
